evidence.title: Jean MCP tool catalog
evidence.finding: Jean MCP exposes project, worktree (create from GitHub issue/PR, Linear issue or advisory), session (create_session with backend choice, send_chat_message, cancel_session_run, delete_session, read_session_messages, set_session_model), GitHub/Linear issue listing, secrets, commit/push/PR/merge and run_review tools; no tool creates or edits GitHub/Linear issues.

evidence.title: Jean MCP dispatch gate
evidence.finding: Session-spawning tools are rate limited per source; agent Jean-tool allowlists and read-only subagent blocks apply; the destructive-tool approval gate runs only for Agents sessions. send_chat_message arms chat-to-chat delegation for regular chat callers.

evidence.title: Agent approval gate
evidence.finding: delete_worktree, push_worktree, merge_pull_request, create_pull_request, remove_project and set_connector wait for user approval only when the caller is an Agents session.

evidence.title: Chat-to-chat delegation
evidence.finding: A lead chat that sends work to another session through send_chat_message gets the end of that run back as a queued message; outcomes are batched, children needing the user are reported at once, and children are followed in the lead sub-session panel.

evidence.title: Jean MCP preferences
evidence.finding: Jean MCP is exposed to spawned CLIs by default, with a max recursive spawn depth of 3 and 20 session-spawning calls per minute per source.

evidence.title: Mr. Robot settings
evidence.finding: Per-project interval, issue limit, max parallel worktrees, included/excluded labels, planning backend/model, optional auto-yolo backend/model and active hours.

evidence.title: Mr. Robot scheduler
evidence.locator: L167-L172; L441-L458 select_issue_numbers_to_start; L547 start_auto_fix_scheduler; L956-L993
evidence.finding: The scheduler runs in jean-core, skips issues already handled or starting, respects the limit and refuses a second concurrent scan; a project is due by interval and active window.

evidence.title: Session secrets
evidence.finding: Secrets entered on request_secret cards go to owner-only (0600) files under app data, never into chat or model context; scoped to the project (or agent); kept until forgotten or 24 hours; not a security wall because agents run as the same OS user.

evidence.title: Web Access browser sessions
evidence.finding: A browser exchanges the single access token for an HttpOnly session cookie with 30-day sliding expiry; sessions are bound to the token fingerprint, so regenerating the token signs out every browser; failed attempts are limited per IP. No per-user identity exists.

evidence.title: Agents experimental switch
evidence.finding: Agents are closed to new users: the Experimental switch only renders for users who already enabled it, and turning it off cannot be undone.

evidence.title: Multi-server session list
evidence.finding: The native app lists sessions from every online server (local and remote) together.

evidence.title: Codex agent threads
evidence.finding: Codex sessions are started with agents.max_threads = 3.

evidence.title: License
evidence.finding: Apache License 2.0 for the repository, which contains the desktop app, jean-core and the headless server.

evidence.title: Data persistence guide
evidence.finding: App data holds preferences.json, projects.json with three rotating backups and emergency recovery JSON files.

evidence.title: Agents database
evidence.finding: Agents data is kept in a SQLite database in app data.

evidence.title: Push rejection handling
evidence.finding: A push rejected as non-fast-forward or fetch-first is detected so Jean can merge the remote and retry.

evidence.title: CodeRabbit CLI integration
evidence.finding: CodeRabbit CLI is a helper for secondary code review, installable and logged in from General preferences.

evidence.title: Web entry

evidence.title: Jean GitLab issue provider (v1.0.16)

evidence.finding: The v1.0.16 GitLab issue provider reads external GitLab issue data through glab and converts it to issue context; this is an external tracker integration, not a native Jean issue catalog.

evidence.title: Jean server continuity
evidence.locator: Local and remote, in one sidebar; Agents keep running
evidence.finding: The home page explicitly says agents on a dedicated server keep running after the controlling laptop closes; jean-server serves the same projects and sessions to browser and native clients.

evidence.title: Jean diff viewer (v1.0.16)
evidence.locator: GitDiffModal implementation, including the exported component
evidence.finding: The v1.0.16 frontend implements GitDiffModal, with diff viewing and file navigation. This pinned implementation supplements the earlier README/release evidence for the review interface.

evidence.title: Jean optional Sentry issue context
evidence.finding: The guide documents starting a session from Sentry issues when Sentry is configured for the project, alongside GitHub and Linear context.

Matches are the Sentry-issues integration (jean-core/src/projects/sentry_issues.rs, user-supplied token) and minified browser-helper code; the only coollabs/jean.build URLs are an optional MCP server entry and a sponsorship link.
